response.justification: Bogdan has broad engineering experience across languages and domains, including Java and JVM-related work in past roles, but his recent focus is overwhelmingly on TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with no clear evidence of recent enterprise JVM tooling or IDE development. His open-source projects and talks show strong technical curiosity and communication skills, but the resume lacks depth in Spring, build tools, or IDE internals — key requirements for this role.
strengths: Demonstrated ability to work across diverse tech stacks and systems
Strong open-source contributions and technical communication via workshops
Experience with Java in past roles and low-level system development
concerns: No recent or prominent experience with Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate
Lack of demonstrable IDE or language tooling projects in JVM ecosystem
Primary recent stack is TypeScript/Node.js, not JVM-based enterprise tooling
